what: A headline wordmark (SVG) filling the screen width shrinks from its own height (154px at 1440 width) to 36px, bound directly to scroll (no curve) while scrolling down by the headline height from the top, and stays at 36px below that. The width stays the same, so the letters shrink toward the top left and the big name becomes a small logo. Not shrunk at widths of 768px or less

options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Art to shrink (child, together if several) — if none, all svg inside the element. preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMid" Attach it
options.dist: Distance to scroll until it has fully shrunk (px), default element height
options.min-width: At or below this width (px) it is not reduced, default 768

note: On window resize, release the height and re-measure after .15s (same as the original)
